1.text: Bhagwan devotees are not easily blessed in this world. Wealth increases arrogance and madness. So HE makes them humble and get a balanced state of mind before offering prosperity. There is no question of Bhagwan devotee's downfall.

2.text: There are people who pray Brahma and Shiva who can be easily pleased and angered, according to their nature. Due to absence of long standing goal, they are not successful in this attempt and end up angering the devatha. Vrikasuran, son of Shakuni is a best example.

3.text: Once, Vrikasuran enquired Naradha as to which God will give darshan easily on prayers. Naradha suggested praying to Lord Shiva as Krishna Bhagwan is never happy with people possessing bad virtues.

4.text: Vrikasuran did severe penance for seven days and on the seventh day, he tried to cut his head. Shiva gave darshan to Vrikasuran. Immediately Vrikasuran requested cruel boon, that the person on whose head he keeps his hand, that person should die. It is quite natural for non-devotees of Krishna to not possess good thoughts or actions.

5.text: Lord Shiva granted the boon. Immediately Vrikasuran tried to test this on Shiva himself. Shiva ran here and there to protect himself, but none in the three worlds came to his support. Finally Shiva was reaching Vaikunta. Seeing the asura running towards Vaikunta, Krishna in the guise of a clever Brahmachaari went and stood before him.

6.text: Krishna asked Vrikasuran, why he was running here and there to test the boon when he could try on his head itself. Vrikasuran attracted by the charm of the Brahmachaari, without thinking kept his hand on his head and fell like a tree whose root was cut. Such is the fate of the people who worship other deities. Thus Krishna only protected Lord Shiva.

7.text: Once sages living along Saraswati river got a doubt as to which God among trinities is more sattvic in nature, They sent sage Bhrigu to the three lokas on this mission. On reaching Brahma loka, Bhrigu did not pray to Brahma which angered him but then he controlled it. Next Bhrigu went to Shiva. Lord Shiva on seeing Bhrigu coming, ran towards him to hug him. Bhrigu pulled himself off which angered Shiva, however, Parvathy pacified Shiva. Then Bhrigu reached Vaikunta.

8.text: Krishna was sleeping on Mahalakshmi's lap. Sage Bhrigu went and kicked Bhagwan on HIS chest. Krishna got up immediately, begged pardon and said the scar made by Bhrigu's kicking will remain like a jewel in HIS chest always.

9.text: Sages at Saraswati river learnt about this incident through Bhrigu and concluded that Krishna is the only GOD to have sattvic virtue the most. The sages since then were completely devoted to Bhagwan and reached Moksham.

10.text: Bhattathiri worshipped the Sattva form of Lord, which never had the quality of downfall from its total sattvic nature. When this universe was formed, the vedas and upanishads glorified Bhagwan. HE is the only God who is in Sat-Chit-ananda form, Advaitha form and Paramatma. Bhattathiri offered worship to Bhagwan, who is the fortune of Gopikas, to protect him from all sorrows.
